notes: Sizes and sha256 are the HTTP body of url. fps is ffprobe avg_frame_rate of the video stream. Nothing was re-encoded.
Replaces the Sintel trailer and the Elephants Dream teaser. Drops the silent lunar render. Keeps the Big Buck Bunny trailer and The Domain (30000/1001).
No native 30/1 clip with an audio track fit under the 200000000 byte cap. download.blender.org bbb_sunflower_1080p_30fps_normal.mp4.zip is 275524128 bytes. The Domain stays the 29.97 clip.

Kept windows are from first_cut on this four-clip set. Sort is container creation_time, then filename. bbb-extract.ogv has no creation_time and sorts first, so it grows. daily-dweebs.webm then grows only to 8.820s, before its end card. Renaming the files changes who grows.

Window check used silencedetect=n=-38dB:d=1.2, blackdetect=d=0.2:pix_th=0.10, freezedetect=n=-55dB:d=1.4 on an accurate trim of each kept source span. No threshold was changed. The same trim after the warm grade, and the four windows joined in cut order, also printed no detector lines.
Inventory treats .ogv as video so the Big Buck Bunny extract is a clip. Blender Studio's remixing page says studio content is generally CC-BY. The Daily Dweebs file on Commons is CC-BY-4.0.
